name: Gull Cave
notes: Tutorial. Sea cave under Mycenor Cliffs. Teaches move/attack/torch/push blocks.

name: Lerna Marsh Sanctum
notes: Seal I. Boardwalks, flooding rooms, water levels. Hydra: burn the stumps.

name: Nemean Cave
notes: Seal II. Dark caves, rolling boulders, push puzzles. Lion: immune to blades, wrestle then hit pelt gap.

name: Artemis Wood Shrine
notes: Seal III. Forest maze, moving hedges, archery switches. Hind: arrows while it circles the arena.

name: Senate Palace
boss: Gold Legate Tiberius Auric, then Aurelia (duel)
notes: Act I climax. Infiltration, guards, secret passage. Ends with the Gilding of Aventina.

name: Forge of Hephaestus
notes: Lemnos volcano. Fire/lava rooms. Iron Ring blocks Gilding.

name: Frostpeak Den
notes: Seal IV. Ice slides, snow bridges, wind. Boar charges into pillars.

name: Augean Stables
notes: Seal V. Flood the stables by redirecting rivers; water-level puzzles.

name: Stymphalian Mere
notes: Seal VI. Reed towers, bird swarms, wind sail platforms.

name: Labyrinth of Knossos
notes: Seal VII. Maze with thread switches; thread tethers across gaps.

name: Stables of Diomedes
item: Reins of Diomedes (horse whistle: fast travel)
notes: Seal VIII. Fortress, horse-chase sections, spiked pits.

name: Themiscyra Fortress
notes: Seal IX. Amazon fortress, shield-guard enemies, reflect puzzles.

name: Erytheia Pastures
notes: Seal X. Island ranch dungeon, cattle stampede rooms, triple-split boss.

name: Garden of the Hesperides
notes: Seal XI. Golden hedge maze, sleeping dragon puzzle.

name: Avernus Descent
notes: Seal XII. Underworld: Styx boat, Asphodel fields, Hades' court.

name: Tartarus Spire
boss: Midas the Gilded, then Aurelia, then Kronos-Saturn (3 phases)
notes: Final. Boss-rush of earlier bosses, then the three-phase finale.

name: Sunken Temple of Tritonis
item: Trident of Poseidon (water jet, current switches)
notes: Optional. Underwater halls, current switches, air pockets. Athena was born at this lake.

name: Gorgon's Lair
notes: Optional. Reflect-shield puzzles. (Cold Strand sea cave.)
